v2.ui.tagline: 6 people, one city, no easy calls. Talk it out loud.
v2.ui.shareHint: Share the code. 4 seats minimum to begin.
v2.ui.commitPrompt: Where do you stand? Commit in secret.
v2.ui.commitHint: Everyone reveals at once. No peeking.
v2.ui.challengePrompt: Surprised by someone? Ask them — out loud. You can still change your mind.
v2.ui.roleOutcomes: What it cost each of you
v2.role.hospital.name: Hospital Director
v2.role.hospital.blurb: The wards are your people. Keep them alive.
v2.role.infrastructure.name: Infrastructure Chief
v2.role.infrastructure.blurb: If the lights and water fail, nothing else matters.
v2.role.economy.name: Economic Steward
v2.role.economy.blurb: A city that goes broke can't save anyone.
v2.role.trust.name: Public Trust Liaison
v2.role.trust.blurb: Lose the people's faith and you've lost the city.
v2.role.emergency.name: Emergency Commander
v2.role.emergency.blurb: When it breaks, your crews are the ones who go in.
v2.role.community.name: Community Representative
v2.role.community.blurb: You speak for the street, not the office.
v2.ending.thriving.text: You didn't just survive it. You kept the city whole.
v2.ending.holding.text: Scarred and tired — but still standing.
v2.ending.fractured.text: You made it through. Something didn't.
v2.ending.collapse.text: It came apart in your hands.
v2.outcome.stable: {role} — your part of the city held.
v2.outcome.strained: {role} — your part is strained, but standing.
v2.cred.true: You raised a warning nobody would confirm. It was true, and it came too late to matter.
v2.cred.false: You put an unverified word on the table. It turned out wrong.
v2.water.title: The water
v2.water.brief: The main reservoir's gone bad. Three days of clean water left, maybe less. We decide now.
v2.water.info.hospital: The east ward is more exposed than anyone's saying — the sick and old are there.
v2.water.info.economy: A full shutdown will cost far more than the officials are admitting.
v2.water.info.infra: Engineers can fix the filtration in three days — if they get priority power.
v2.water.o_fix.title: Fix filtration first
v2.water.o_fix.result: Crews reroute power to the filters. Taps run thin, but a real fix is coming.
v2.water.o_ration.title: Ration hard, right now
v2.water.o_ration.result: Everyone tightens their belt. The outer streets feel singled out.
v2.water.o_wait.title: Tell people to boil it
v2.water.o_wait.result: No rationing, no panic. People boil their water and move on.
v2.power.title: The grid
v2.power.brief: A substation's failing. There isn't enough power for everyone at once. Who gets it?
v2.power.callout.contamination: The water was never really safe — now the fever's spreading, and it needs power to fight.
v2.power.callout.fixed: The filtration work paid off — clean water is holding the line.
v2.power.info.infra: If we push the grid past this, we risk a cascade that takes days to undo.
v2.power.info.emergency: My crews say the industrial district could go dark for a week and still recover.
v2.power.o_hospital.title: Power to the hospitals
v2.power.o_hospital.result: The wards stay lit. Whole sectors go dark, and they notice.
v2.power.o_spread.title: Spread it thin, fairly
v2.power.o_spread.result: Nobody's fully covered, but nobody's abandoned either.
v2.power.o_industry.title: Keep industry running
v2.power.o_industry.result: The money keeps flowing. The clinics run on generators and prayers.
v2.unrest.title: The square
v2.unrest.brief: People are in the streets. Angry, loud, and not leaving. This tips one way or the other tonight.
v2.unrest.callout.resentment: The rationing never sat right with the outer streets. This is where it comes back.
v2.unrest.callout.dark: The sectors you left in the dark are the ones out here now.
v2.unrest.info.trust: They'll disperse if one of us goes out and actually listens. Send the wrong face and it explodes.
v2.unrest.info.community: I hear there's someone stirring this on purpose — but I can't prove it.
v2.unrest.o_talk.title: Go out and listen
v2.unrest.o_talk.result: It takes all night, but the square empties on its own. It costs to make the promises stick.
v2.unrest.o_force.title: Clear the square
v2.unrest.o_force.result: It's quiet by morning. It's the kind of quiet that remembers.
v2.unrest.o_ignore.title: Wait it out
v2.unrest.o_ignore.result: You hold the line and say nothing. The anger doesn't leave — it settles in.
v2.storm.title: The storm
v2.storm.brief: A surge is coming and the north wall is failing. This is the one that decides everything. Choose.
v2.storm.callout.heavy: The way the square was handled — people remember. Not everyone will pull with you tonight.
v2.storm.info.emergency: We can hold the wall, or save the stores, or move the people. Not all three.
v2.storm.o_together.title: Everyone to the wall
v2.storm.o_together.result: The city pulls together and holds the line — if it still trusts itself enough to.
v2.storm.o_spend.title: Spend everything to reinforce
v2.storm.o_spend.result: The wall holds. The treasury doesn't.
v2.storm.o_evacuate.title: Move the people, lose the ground
v2.storm.o_evacuate.result: People live. The built city is given to the water.
